description: Verification-first supplement ingredient evidence and current product formulation research.

interface.shortDescription: Research supplement ingredients and product formulations.
interface.longDescription: Review verification-first supplement ingredient evidence, safety context, study directness, and current tracked product formulations without treating ingredient evidence as proof of finished-product efficacy.
